scope: Live OpenAI Decisions gpt-6-luna using public TypeScript/TSX added lines; default built-in packs and thresholds; 8 s per hook budget; external watchdog per hook at 22 s; max eight files per hook, sequential groups for larger PRs. PR latency includes all groups and observed failed attempts, excludes GitHub retrieval and benchmarking daemon setup. Elapsed failure time is not time to successful review.
sampling: Up to 30 recent PRs per repository. All states for Jev Lint; merged for Ky and p-limit. Complete GitHub patches with at most 12 relevant files, 24k chars/file and 80k chars/PR; duplicate content removed. 37 PRs outside the previous nine. Small, nonrandom source sample.
quality: Micro file/rule counts over frozen blinded Responses labels. Same model family, low reasoning effort. Missing findings on failed files count as misses. Plus parser reference for explicit any and postfix non-null using verified full GitHub blobs and added token lines.

syntax.method: Parse each full head blob after verifying the Git object hash. Count AnyKeyword and postfix NonNullExpression exclamation tokens on added lines, once per rule/file. Ignore syntactically invalid files.

modes.control: in-process cold hook; forces daemon off
modes.warm: original four-worker daemon; separate process surviving across reviews
modes.candidate: crossover,quiet,host: warm daemon with explicit whole-operation Decisions deadline. large: deadline plus 8 workers. targeted: deadline plus three revised test-rule gates.
modes.bounded: cold hook with explicit whole-operation deadline (targeted experiment only)

design: Same pinned PRs per arm. Rotating order, separate state per daemon. Across rounds PR order reshuffled. First crossover overlaps pilot for some reviews; quiet repeats without the pilot. Host round ran with host network access and overlapped the final sandbox experiment. Paired 95% percentile bootstrap intervals resample PRs within a round. Pilot omitted from efficacy because optional preconnect failed on this Bun build; all captured pilot usage included in spend.

spend.note: Captured request usage includes cache discounts/writes and grader output. Timed-out requests may lack usage receipts; actual invoice unavailable.

diagnosis.original: Historical PR 14: parent subprocess timeout at 22 s, no child receipts or phase timestamps.
diagnosis.reproduction: On the same pinned PR in quiet, all 3 requests dispatched by 2.712 s, no headers or fetch rejection logged before watchdog at 22.072 s. Similar failures preceded headers on other PRs.
diagnosis.network: Separate sandbox no-key probes: one TCP handshake took 2.609 s, another IPv4 probe and automatic-family probe both expired at 6 s before TCP, after DNS in 3-4 ms. No matching kernel/powerd sleep/pressure events found in original narrow window. Does not isolate the historical connection or provider.
diagnosis.offline: Separate-process localhost stalled headers or body: native timeouts worked in ~255 ms (250 ms budget), including cloned JSON. Mock nonsettling body ignored abort: original hit 1.5 s external watchdog; candidate returned TimeoutError at 167 ms for 160 ms deadline.
